name: e1-engines-gpu
description: E1: vLLM (vllm-metal) vs llama.cpp on the Apple M4 GPU, same Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 GGUF file, closed-loop concurrency sweep. Fixed 128 output tokens (ignore_eos), prefix caching off on both engines so trials are independent and servers can be reused within a repeat. Thinking disabled. Qwen3-0.6B so each engine fits the memory left on a shared 16 GB Mac (another project's kind cluster and desktop apps); larger models are deferred, not dropped.
